sloka: तथा तासां वदन्तीनां परुषं दारुणं बहु ।राक्षसीनामसौम्यानां रुरोद जनकात्मजा ।। ५.२३.१।।।।
transliteration: tathā tāsāṁ vadantīnāṁ paruṣaṁ dāruṇaṁ bahu ।rākṣasīnāmasaumyānāṁ ruroda janakātmajā ।। 5.23.1।।।।

translations.english: King Ravana, tormentor of enemies, having thus spoken to Mythili commanded the demonesses and departed.
